caption: The drawing depicts a long, black velvet cloak or coat with long sleeves and a high, fitted collar. The garment features a fitted bodice that is slightly gathered at the shoulders and decorated with rows of small dark trim or braid. The coat flares out from the waist, with the skirt portion hanging straight and reaching near the floor, displaying subtle highlights and shadows that suggest the texture and sheen of velvet fabric. There is no visible fastening or ornamentation other than the trim along the shoulders and the waist, which is also decorated with similar braided detail. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, with no additional objects or scenery; the artist’s signature is located in the bottom right corner. The garment is rendered without a human figure, so it appears to be floating or displayed on an invisible form.
title: Woman's Coat
